evidence: The potential reliance on and integration of artificial intelligence ( AI ) and machine learning ( ML ) technologies expose us to various risks
Operational & Model Risk: Potential AI/ML models, used for credit scoring, fraud detection, customer service, and investment decisions
Data Security & Privacy: AI systems process sensitive customer data
ai_positioning.summary: La société utilise l'IA en interne pour améliorer ses services tels que la détection de fraude et le scoring de crédit, mais est consciente des risques associés
